Name: Biblically Accurate Emily
Author: wschwick
Description: Edits Emily's sprites a bit to make her butt bigger. It was hard to do this with the pixel art since a small change can make a huge difference, and Emily's sprite actually has a bigger butt than most of the other characters already. So full disclosure some of the sprites look a little ridiculous, but I don't care I'm down bad.
